yates-cider-mill.summary: Take your cider outside and make this a Rochester Hills outing, with the mill as the starting point rather than the whole afternoon. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

franklin-cider-mill.summary: Go for the cider and warm donuts; stay for the story of a mill whose history reaches back to Michigan’s statehood year.

parmenters-northville-cider-mill.summary: Pick up cider in Northville, then spend some time exploring the town around it. This is a short-season stop with a firm final day.

diehls-orchard-and-cider-mill.summary: Make a final November cider-and-donut stop in Holly, then choose a nearby woodland walk if conditions allow. November weekends, noon to 5 p.m.

parshallville-cider-mill.summary: Seek out the old mill on Ore Creek for a quieter, history-led cider outing. The mill lists Labor Day weekend through mid-November, weather permitting, but publishes no 2026 final day.

macqueen-orchards.summary: Head into the Ohio side of the Orbit for an orchard-market visit that continues beyond pumpkin season. Shop the market and bakery rather than expecting October’s outdoor attractions. Market open year-round except major holidays (November to April, 9 to 6); the outdoor fall attractions are separate.

long-family-orchard-and-farm.summary: Commerce Township orchard and farm market with fresh-pressed cider through Thanksgiving Eve. The Fun Farm and corn maze ended November 1.

plymouth-orchards-and-cider-mill.summary: Plymouth orchard with award-winning cider and donuts. The cider mill's last day is November 8. The separate Red Shed Market, at another address, stays open through November 25.

stony-creek-orchard-and-cider-mill.summary: Orchard and cider mill with U-pick apples and raspberries, moonlight hayrides, a farm stand, cider and donuts. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

obstbaum-orchards.summary: Family orchard with U-pick apples when ripe, fresh-pressed cider, donuts and hayrides. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

erie-orchards-and-cider-mill.summary: Orchard and cider mill with pumpkin picking, blueberry and peach picking, hayrides, donuts, cider and caramel apples. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

dexter-cider-mill.summary: Historic riverside cider mill with cinnamon doughnuts, fresh-pressed cider, caramel apples and outdoor seating along the Huron River. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

blakes-orchard-cider-mill.summary: Cider mill and orchard at Blake Farms with U-pick, a tasting room, Funland and a store and bakery. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

blakes-big-apple.summary: Fall farm at Blake Farms with U-pick apples and pumpkins, a corn maze, an animal farm, Funland and haunted attractions. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

blakes-backyard.summary: Blake Farms market, taproom and U-pick with a greenhouse, a tree nursery and fall bonfires. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

bonadeo-farms.summary: Farm with a corn maze, pumpkin patch, hayrides, cider and donuts, and a haunted house on weekend evenings. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

alber-orchard-and-cider-mill.summary: Orchard and cider mill with heirloom and traditional apples, cider and hard cider, pumpkins and the Freedom Winery. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

porters-orchard.summary: Orchard, farm market and cider mill in Goodrich with fresh-picked apples, cider and donuts. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

schell-family-farm.summary: Family farm with pumpkins, apples, a fruit orchard and wagon rides. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

gust-brothers-pumpkin-farm.summary: Fall farm with a you-pick pumpkin patch, a corn maze, hayrides, farm animals, cider and donuts. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

goodison-cider-mill.summary: Goodison Cider Mill in Rochester. Official page lists fresh-pressed cider, donuts, pistachio nut bread, pies. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

damouni-orchards.summary: Damouni Orchards in Flint. Official page lists U-pick Honeycrisp and Gala apples, country store, Coop Tasting Room, cider donuts pre-order. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

nixon-farms-blast-corn-maze.summary: Working farm with the Blast Corn Maze, a U-pick pumpkin patch, tractor-drawn hayrides and a corn cannon. The 2026 closing date isn't published.

kreps-apple-barn-and-cider-mill.summary: Orchard and cider mill with an animal barn, a corn maze, a sunflower trail and U-cut flowers. The farm's page mentions wrapping up on November 25 but gives no year.

wasem-fruit-farm.summary: Fruit farm in Milan with pick-your-own apples and pumpkins. Its page lists November Fridays and Saturdays through the 21st but is out of date.

wiards-orchards.summary: Orchard, cider mill and country store in Ypsilanti. The corn maze, slide, wagon rides and petting farm are listed as temporarily closed with no reopening date; November hours vary (734-482-7744).

three-cedars-farm.summary: Cider Donut Hut and country store, open Nov. 6–8 from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. The farm is closed Nov. 2–5 and Nov. 9–26, then returns for Country Christmas, Nov. 27–Dec. 20.

highland-state-recreation-area.summary: Follow the woodland story at Haven Hill, where forest and the remains of Edsel Ford’s retreat share the same landscape.

cranbrook-gardens-and-grounds.summary: Look for the shape of the landscape at Cranbrook: paths, trees and the Japanese Garden give this walk a story beyond fall color. Grounds hours are listed as 8 to 5 in fall and winter, but the garden's own pages differ, so hours aren't confirmed.

wadhams-to-avoca-trail.summary: Walk the former railway over Mill Creek and see the valley from its historic trestle. Make the structure and landscape the story, with autumn color as a bonus.

holiday-beach-conservation-area.summary: Conservation area with trails, a boardwalk and a viewing tower, known for fall hawk migration. The conservation authority lists day use from mid-April to the end of October and publishes nothing for November.

point-pelee-national-park.summary: National park of forest, marsh and lakeshore with hiking trails, and a stopover for migrating Monarch butterflies each autumn. Parks Canada lists the park as temporarily closed to visitors November 12 to 23, 2026 (no reason given), and the Visitor Centre is closed November 2, 2026 to March 31, 2027.
